_meta.note: Clinical coverage register (Package E) — what the engine scores, what's intentionally a gate, what's genuinely missing, and the self-report representation. Rendered on production-gaps.html. Drives the disposition of the audit's gap:/selfreport: flags. Illustrative — NOT a clinical sign-off.

legend.missing: not in the engine; on the roadmap
legend.present: already in the engine (flag was stale)

markers.name: Diastolic BP
markers.plan: Add scored CV marker (th 80/90, hi), paired with SBP — required for correct hypertension staging; flagged repeatedly (no-dbp).

markers.name: Lp(a)
markers.plan: Add once-in-lifetime CV marker (nmol/L, very-high ≥430). Display row + citation exist; not yet a scored marker.

markers.name: non-HDL-C
markers.plan: Derive = Total cholesterol − HDL-C; ESC secondary lipid target, robust to fasting/triglycerides.

markers.name: Sodium
markers.plan: Add electrolyte (acute/critical) alongside potassium for a complete electrolyte panel.

markers.name: Free T4
markers.plan: Add ENDO marker (pairs with TSH to separate overt vs subclinical thyroid disease).

markers.name: UACR / albuminuria
markers.plan: Already scored (calc-graph.markers.uacr) — the 'missing' flag is stale; unit now SI-gated (mg/mmol path).

markers.name: 25-OH Vitamin D
markers.plan: Already scored (calc-graph.markers.vitd) — the 'missing' flag is stale; re-based to IOM with nmol/L path.

gates.name: G6PD-deficiency gate
gates.plan: Population-SAFETY gate (not scored): modifies HbA1c reliability and oxidative-stress/anaemia interpretation. High Gulf prevalence — first-order for this cohort.

gates.name: Ethnicity / ancestry gate
gates.plan: Selects ethnicity-specific cut-points (waist, BMI, eGFR race-free, HOMA-IR). Multi-ethnic, high-consanguinity Gulf cohort.

gates.name: Consanguinity / family-history item
gates.plan: Intake item → HEM/genetic-risk weighting; high Gulf consanguinity raises haemoglobinopathy/recessive-disease prior.

gates.name: Hemoglobinopathy frame
gates.plan: Thalassaemia/trait gate across HEM, glycaemic (HbA1c validity) and iron reservoirs — the key Gulf adjustment.

gates.name: Ramadan / fasting-state context
gates.plan: Context flag for fasting-dependent labs (glucose, lipids) and nudge timing during Ramadan.

gates.name: Measurement-method field
gates.plan: Per-marker method tag (lab vs wearable vs PRO; DEXA vs BIA; standardised office vs ambulatory BP) — gates confidence and band choice.

gates.name: Pregnancy / menopause life-stage gate
gates.plan: Gate advertised by the engine but trimester/menopause-specific ranges not yet delivered (orphan citations).

self_report.plan: SAFETY: PHQ-9 item-9 positive must escalate to C-SSRS via the safety layer (Doc 16) — not a silent score tweak.
Instruments catalogued (EPDS, DAST-10, PHQ-15, AUDIT-C…) but not all wired into the question-bank; reconcile item counts & cadence.
Use UAE-validated Arabic PHQ-9/GAD-7/AUDIT-C; resolve standard-drink (US 14g vs UK 8g) and diet-screener scale conflation.
IPAQ-SF vs wearable steps/MVPA cross-check (Appendix L corroboration); down-weight discordant PRO.
FIT/MCS lean on wearable-estimated/PRO inputs at parity with measured — confidence down-weighting (Doc 05).
